verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents AI-driven investigation use cases, such as investigating what changed after a deploy, tuning a noisy alert, and creating dashboards from natural language. The evidence indicates these run through external AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) connected via its official MCP server and Agent Skills, not through a native in-product assistant. That means a user gets AI insights from their data, but only with an outside tool. Missing for 10: a native in-app AI assistant or insight feature, in-product anomaly or root-cause suggestions, detailed docs on how the use cases surface inside the SigNoz UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
